lines.en: label iospecial30:
I wake up to the sound of my phone ringing and the day quickly gets off to a rocky start.
lines.zh: 我在电话铃声中醒来，这一天从一开始就很不顺。

lines.en: Thankfully, phones can’t ring forever. So any second now, this is going to stop and things are going to return to the way they should be at...
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，电话不可能响个不停。所以再过几秒钟，这动静就该停了，一切也会回到本该有的样子，在……
: 早上 7 点……

lines.en: I press a button to ignore the call and-
lines.zh: 我按下一个键挂断电话，然后——

lines.en: Oh, come on.
lines.zh: 哦，别闹了。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hi! Did I wake you?
lines.zh: : 嗨！我把你吵醒了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 是的。再见。

lines.en: : Wait, don’t hang up yet! I have awesome news!
lines.zh: : 等等，先别挂！我有个超棒的消息！

lines.en: : Can the news not wait until, like...two hours from now?
lines.zh: : 这消息就不能等到……比如……两个小时以后再说吗？

lines.en: : I mean, it probably {i}could.{/i} But do I really seem like the type with enough self control to be able to abstain for that long when there’s something I clearly want to tell you about?
lines.zh: : 应该{i}能{/i}吧。但你觉得我像是那种有足够自制力、在明明有件事特别想告诉你的时候还能忍那么久的人吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Anyway, talk to you later.
lines.zh: : 不像。总之，回头聊。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and-
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，然后——

lines.en: You’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
lines.zh: 你他妈一定是在跟我开玩笑吧。

lines.en: scene bedroom_day
: Stop ignoring me and let me share my awesome news with you! If you still don’t think it’s awesome, you can ignore me forever and forget we ever even met.
lines.zh: : 别再无视我了，让我把超棒的消息分享给你嘛！要是你听完还觉得不棒，你可以永远无视我，当我们从没见过。

lines.en: : Except not really because my self-esteem is already pretty horrible and a blow like that would be the final nail in the coffin that is Io.
lines.zh: : 当然那是不可能的，因为我的自尊心本来就已经很糟糕了，那样一记打击会直接给 Io 这口棺材钉上最后一颗钉子。

lines.en: : Just tell me what the news is.
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我是什么消息。

lines.en: : I don’t have to work today!
lines.zh: : 我今天不用上班！

lines.en: : Awesome, right?!
lines.zh: : 很棒吧？！

lines.en: : Is that seriously it?
lines.zh: : 就这个？

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah!
lines.zh: : 基本上，对！

lines.en: : But it’s {i}because{/i} of that that I figured you and me could spend some time together! If that’s not too presumptuous and you don’t already have other plans, which I figured you might.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}正因如此{/i}，我想你和我可以一起待一会儿！如果这不算太自作主张，而且你也没有别的安排——我猜你可能有。

lines.en: : But that’s just one of several reasons I’m calling you as early as this! I didn’t want someone else beating me to the punch and stealing you away before I even get a shot.
lines.zh: : 但这只是我这么早给你打电话的原因之一！我可不想让别人抢先一步，在我还没机会之前就把你拐走。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you’re actually the one reaching out to {i}me{/i} this time when I’m pretty much always the one who finds you first. But I guess your reasoning makes sense.
lines.zh: : 我挺惊讶这次居然是你主动联系{i}我{/i}，平时基本都是我先找到你的。不过你的理由倒也说得通。

lines.en: : Hey, the only reason I don’t call you more often is that I’m still like 85%% sure you’re only pretending to like me. But Uta says I should be more assertive if I’m ever going to get what I want, so hi.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我不常给你打电话的唯一原因，就是我大概还有 85%% 的把握觉得你只是在假装喜欢我。但 Uta 说如果我想得到想要的东西就得再主动一点，所以，嗨。

lines.en: : Anyway, can we hang out? I have something for you.
lines.zh: : 总之，我们能一起玩吗？我有东西要给你。

lines.en: : You do?
lines.zh: : 你有？

lines.en: : Yes. Well, kind of. I found it at a garage sale. But you’ll love it. Maybe. Or not. Probably not, now that I think about it. But I will, so I still want to give it to you.
lines.zh: : 有。嗯，算是吧。我在一场庭院旧货甩卖上淘到的。不过你会喜欢的。也许吧。也可能不会。现在想想大概是不会。但我会喜欢，所以我还是想送给你。

lines.en: : Just come over. I’m pretty sure Ami has work today.
lines.zh: : 直接过来吧。我很确定 Ami 今天要上班。

lines.en: : Come...come over? Like...to your house?
lines.zh: : 过……过来？比如……去你家？

lines.en: : Yes. But I’m going back to sleep until you get here, so goodbye.
lines.zh: : 对。不过在你到之前我要先回去睡一觉，所以再见。

lines.en: : Wait! I don’t know where you live!
lines.zh: : 等等！我不知道你住哪儿！

lines.en: : Ask Uta.
lines.zh: : 问 Uta。

lines.en: : Why does Uta know where you live?!
lines.zh: : Uta 为什么会知道你住哪儿？！

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and collapse back onto the bed.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，倒回床上。

lines.en: I’m not sure if I’m going to be able to get any sleep now that I’ve been torn from my slumber for more than five minutes, but it’s worth a shot.
lines.zh: 我不确定自己被从睡梦里拽出来五分多钟之后还能不能睡着，不过值得一试。

lines.en: And hey, if Io lacks the self confidence or assertiveness to come over here (Which I figure there is a 50%% chance she will), I’m sure that just staying in bed will be enough to at least partially rejuvenate me.
lines.zh: 而且话说回来，万一 Io 缺乏自信或者不够主动、不会自己过来（我觉得她有 50%% 的概率会来），光是赖在床上也足够让我恢复一部分元气了。

lines.en: I close my eyes, unsure of how the day is going to proceed...
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，不知道这一天会怎么展开……

lines.en: scene bedroom_day
But when I open them roughly two hours later to the sound of my doorbell being repeatedly pressed, I figure it out.
lines.zh: 但大约两个小时后，我在被反复按响的门铃声中睁开眼睛时，我明白了。

lines.en: : Well, at least she gave me an extra two hours.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少她多给了我两个小时。

lines.en: scene black
scene iocomesover1
: Wow! It’s just as normal as I thought it would be!
lines.zh: : 哇！跟我想象的一样普通！

lines.en: : Thank...you?
: Ooooh, and your TV is huge! Do you get all of the sports channels? Or any of the American ones?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，而且你的电视好大！能收到所有的体育频道吗？还是说有美国的频道？

lines.en: scene iocomesover2
: Well, not like we’ll have any time to watch anything anyway. Not with what I’ve got planned for the two of us.
lines.zh: : 反正我们大概也没时间看电视了。有我给咱们俩安排的东西在呢。

lines.en: : You know it.
lines.zh: : 那还用说。

lines.en: : Are you ready for the ride of your life, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 准备好迎接你人生中最刺激的一段旅程了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : If I knew that’s what you were calling about, I wouldn’t have asked you to wait two-
lines.zh: : 我要是知道你打电话来是为了这个，我就不会让你等两个——

lines.en: scene iocomesover3
: Because it’s time for the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon!
lines.zh: : 因为现在是时候玩 1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》了！

lines.en: : Sweet, right?
lines.zh: : 很赞吧？

lines.en: scene iocomesover4
: What’s wrong? Are you not interested in the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你对 1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》不感兴趣吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to refer to it by that lengthy title every time?
lines.zh: : 你每次都要用那么长的全称来称呼它吗？

lines.en: : It’s a relic of the past. I thought repeatedly saying its release year might unlock some core memories for you that lead to the two of us playing it until it gets dark and I have to go home.
lines.zh: : 这是过去的遗物。我想反复念它的发售年份，也许能帮你解锁一些核心记忆，然后我们俩就能一直玩到天黑、直到我不得不回家为止。

lines.en: : I’m not that interested in video games, Io.
lines.zh: : 我对电子游戏没那么感兴趣，Io。

lines.en: : Not even the 1999 PC classic-
lines.zh: : 连 1999 年的 PC 经典——

lines.en: : Not even the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon.
lines.zh: : 连 1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》也不感兴趣。

lines.en: scene iocomesover5
: But I spent like 500 yen on this!
lines.zh: : 可我在这上面花了差不多 500 日元呢！

lines.en: : That’s not even that much.
lines.zh: : 那也不算多啊。

lines.en: : Also, you still haven’t taken me to an amusement park so it’s very considerate that I would bring the amusement park to {i}you{/i} instead! This is significantly cheaper and only like, three degrees less fun!
lines.zh: : 再说了，你还没带我去过游乐园，所以我把游乐园带到{i}你{/i}面前，是不是很贴心！这样便宜多了，而且乐趣只比真的去玩少了那么一点点！

lines.en: : I mean...I {i}guess{/i} we can play if you’re that excited about it. But are you really content with just spending all of our time together playing video games?
lines.zh: : 嗯……既然你这么兴奋，那我们{i}就{/i}玩吧。不过你真的满足于把所有相处的时间都花在打游戏上吗？

lines.en: scene iocomesover6
: Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : There’s nothing else you’d rather do instead?
lines.zh: : 就没有别的你想做的事？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Everything else sounds exhausting. And every time Uta and I have played games like this together, it’s been a total blast.
lines.zh: : 别的事情光是想想就累。而且每次我和 Uta 一起玩这种游戏，都玩得特别开心。

lines.en: : There’s {i}really{/i} nothing you’d rather do?
lines.zh: : {i}真的{/i}没有别的你想做的事？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : {i}Nothing?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么都没有？{/i}

lines.en: scene iocomesover7
: You’re being a real creep today, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你今天真像个变态。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and think back to what Uta said at the love hotel the other day.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，回想起那天在情人旅馆 Uta 说过的话。

lines.en: And while I’m still not sure exactly how accurate that assessment of hers is (Ignoring the fact that she probably knows more about Io than I do), I’m not about to just come out and {i}ask{/i} Io about it.
lines.zh: 虽然我仍然不确定她的那番评价到底有多准确（更别提她大概比我还了解 Io），但我也不打算直接去{i}问{/i} Io。

lines.en: If she wants to play the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon, then...
lines.zh: 如果她想玩 1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》，那么……

lines.en: Well, I guess the two of us are going to play the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来我们俩是要玩 1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》了。

lines.en: scene black
: Oh! Which one is your room? I don’t want to accidentally walk into Ami’s and have my eyes singed by how pink and girly everything probably is.
lines.zh: : 哦！哪间是你的房间？我可不想不小心闯进 Ami 的房间，被里面那些粉嫩少女的东西刺瞎眼睛。

lines.en: : It’s the one on the left.
lines.zh: : 左边那间。

lines.en: : Cool! That means- ah! My eyes! They burn! You lied to me!
lines.zh: : 酷！也就是说——啊！我的眼睛！好烫！你骗我！

lines.en: I lead Io to my {i}actual{/i} room after destroying her eyesight, which she takes as an invitation to immediately run up to my table and start playing with my things.
lines.zh: 在摧毁了 Io 的视力之后，我把她领到了我{i}真正{/i}的房间，而她把这当成了邀请，立刻冲到我的桌子旁开始摆弄我的东西。

lines.en: scene iocomesover8
Granted, she is the one who {i}created{/i} the thing she is currently playing with. But still, touching other peoples’ belongings is rude.
lines.zh: 话说回来，她现在摆弄的那个东西本来就是她{i}自己做{/i}的。但即便如此，随便碰别人的东西还是很没礼貌。

lines.en: : You kept it! You kept it and didn’t throw it in the trash even though it was made by a trash person who previously put and is currently putting her trash hands all over it!
lines.zh: : 你居然留着！你居然留着它没扔进垃圾桶，尽管它是个垃圾人做的，而且那个垃圾人之前还把她的垃圾手放上去过、现在还正放在上面！

lines.en: : I wouldn’t just throw away something you made for me.
lines.zh: : 你给我做的东西，我不会随便扔掉。

lines.en: : Even that wardrobe thing is still around here somewhere. I just had to move it out of the bedroom since it was taking up way too much space.
lines.zh: : 就连那个衣柜似的东西也还在哪儿放着。我只是不得不把它搬出卧室，因为它太占地方了。

lines.en: : That’s fine! A 50%% success rate combined with a 0%% garbage rate is way better than I thought I’d get, so thank you!
lines.zh: : 那就好！50%% 的成功率加上 0%% 的垃圾率，比我预想的好太多了，所以谢谢你！

lines.en: : How you doing, little guy? Is Sensei treating you well?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，小家伙？Sensei 对你好吗？

lines.en: : Have you seen him doing anything weird under the blanket? Or does he make you turn away for that?
lines.zh: : 你有没有看到他在被子里做什么奇怪的事？还是说他会让你转过身去？

lines.en: : Please don’t talk to my robot that way.
lines.zh: : 别那样跟我的机器人说话。

lines.en: Not after the things he has seen...
lines.zh: 在他目睹过那些事情之后……

lines.en: scene iocomesover9
: Can he play with us? He is technically one of my offspring, so there’s no way he doesn’t also enjoy the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon.
lines.zh: : 他能跟我们一起玩吗？严格来说他算是我的后代之一，所以他不可能不喜欢 1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》。

lines.en: if robotname.lower() in ["1999 pc classic, rollercoaster tycoon"]:
: You know, despite him not being able to talk, I knew from the get-go that he loved that game.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，尽管他不会说话，我从一开始就看出他喜欢那款游戏。

lines.en: : Which is exactly why I decided to name him after it.
lines.zh: : 正因如此，我决定用它的名字给他命名。

lines.en: scene iocomesover8
: You didn’t!
lines.zh: : 你不会吧！

lines.en: : I certainly did.
lines.zh: : 我当然会。

lines.en: : How are you doing, 1999 PC Classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon?!
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，1999 年 PC 经典《过山车大亨》？！

lines.en: : Are you having fun?! Are you having a good time?!
lines.zh: : 你玩得开心吗？！你现在愉快吗？！

lines.en: : I also taught him Spanish so he has no idea what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 我还教了他西班牙语，所以他完全听不懂你在说什么。

lines.en: : That’s fine. He can just be confused along with the rest of the people who had to go into the code to find this additional dialogue since no one would ever actually name him 1999 PC Classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正除了他以外，那些为了看到这段额外对话而不得不翻代码的人也一样困惑，毕竟没人会真的给他起名叫 1999 年 PC 经典《过山车大亨》。

lines.en: : Anyway, back onto the topic of whether or not he can play-
lines.zh: : 总之，回到他到底能不能玩这个话题——

lines.en: : I guess. But I have no idea if he’ll enjoy it or not.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过我不知道他会不会喜欢。

lines.en: : Or...if he’s even capable of enjoying anything because he is an inanimate hunk of wood.
lines.zh: : 或者……他到底有没有能力喜欢任何东西，毕竟他就是一块没有生命的木头。

lines.en: : For now! But in about 99 years, he’ll be very mad that you said that.
lines.zh: : 暂时是！但再过大概 99 年，他会因为你说的这句话而非常生气。

lines.en: scene black
Io takes the robot over to my desk and places him down beside my laptop.
lines.zh: Io 把机器人拿到我的书桌旁，把它放在我的笔记本电脑旁边。

lines.en: Thankfully, the laptop is old enough to still have a disc drive, so Io pops the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon into the tray and, after an outdated installation screen, she loads up the game.
lines.zh: 幸好这台笔记本够老，还带着光驱，于是 Io 把 1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》塞进托盘，在一个过时的安装界面之后，她把游戏打开了。

lines.en: scene iocomesover10
I think to myself as she goes over the basics that this is really similar to the way Niki acts whenever she comes into my room.
lines.zh: 她给我讲基础操作的时候我心里想着，这跟 Niki 每次进我房间时的样子真像。

lines.en: The only difference is that I don’t [[yet] have an extensive sexual history with Io and that she actually tries to include me rather than just seizing my things for her own personal gain.
lines.zh: 唯一的区别是，我还没有跟 Io 有过那么丰富的性经历，而且她是真的想把我拉进来，而不只是为了自己的好处把我的东西据为己有。

lines.en: We play for an hour or two. And when I say {i}we{/i}, I mean {i}me-{/i} as Io vehemently refuses to play at all in favor of trying to get me addicted.
lines.zh: 我们玩了一两个小时。说「{i}我们{/i}」，其实{i}是指我{/i}——因为 Io 坚决不肯玩，执意要让我上瘾。

lines.en: And while her efforts are in vain for the majority of time I spend pressing buttons on this rectangular machine, I do begin to reevaluate that when she begins teaching me the {i}secrets{/i} of this game.
lines.zh: 虽然在我对着这台长方形机器按按钮的大部分时间里，她的努力都是白费的，但当她开始教我这款游戏的{i}诀窍{/i}时，我确实开始重新评估这一点。

lines.en: : So, yeah. If you just delete parts of the tracks on your rollercoasters, you can send all of your guests flying to their deaths.
lines.zh: : 所以说，只要你把过山车轨道的一部分删掉，就能让所有游客飞出去摔死。

lines.en: : What I like to do is position them so that the carts go flying into the water, causing everyone to drown.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢把轨道摆成小车飞进水里的样子，让所有人淹死。

lines.en: : It’s kind of like how in the 2000 PC classic, The Sims, you could delete the ladder on your swimming pool and laugh as all of the characters you created slowly drown to death.
lines.zh: : 这有点像 2000 年的 PC 经典《模拟人生》，你可以把游泳池的梯子删掉，然后看着你创造的角色一个个慢慢淹死，哈哈大笑。

lines.en: : Why are you so experienced when it comes to games that existed before you?
lines.zh: : 为什么你对你出生之前的游戏这么熟悉？

lines.en: : Because I am a contrarian and refuse to live the same type of life as my peers, electing to instead participate in activities that others would call outdated or boring so no one tries to connect with me.
lines.zh: : 因为我天生反骨，拒绝和同龄人过一样的生活，反而选择去参与那些别人会叫做过时或者无聊的活动，这样谁都不会想来跟我套近乎。

lines.en: : Oh. And there’s also a Zoo Tycoon where you can make lions eat all of your guests.
lines.zh: : 哦。还有一款《动物园大亨》，你可以让狮子把游客全吃掉。

lines.en: scene iocomesover11
: I think you might have a problem.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能有点问题。

lines.en: : Sensei, if it weren’t for outlets like this where I can get all of my inner rage out in peace, I would probably be in jail for literal murder.
lines.zh: : Sensei，要是没有这种能让我安安静静发泄内心暴怒的出口，我大概早因为货真价实的谋杀罪进监狱了。

lines.en: : I highly doubt you’d have the resolve to actually kill someone.
lines.zh: : 我很怀疑你真有那个胆量去杀人。

lines.en: scene iocomesover12
: Well, thanks to extremely outdated PC hits, we’re probably not going to find out any time soon.
lines.zh: : 嗯，多亏了这些极其过时的 PC 神作，我们大概短期内是找不到答案了。

lines.en: : Besides, going to jail would mean that I don’t get to spend time with you anymore. And days like this are quickly becoming my favorite reason to continue existing.
lines.zh: : 再说，进了监狱我就没法再和你待在一起了。而像今天这样的日子，正在迅速成为我继续活下去的最主要的理由。

lines.en: : I’ll admit this isn’t as bad as I thought it would be.
lines.zh: : 我承认这没我想的那么糟。

lines.en: : Still probably not how I’d choose to spend my time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过大概也不是我自己会选择消磨时间的方式。

lines.en: scene iocomesover13
: Well, we’ve done what I’ve wanted to do for like, two hours already. So if there’s something you had in mind, we could try that instead.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们已经做了两个小时我想做的事了。所以如果你有什么想法，我们可以换个试试。

lines.en: : As long as it doesn’t involve going out, because there is no way I’m going to be into that today. Or...any day.
lines.zh: : 只要不是出门就行，因为今天我绝对不可能想出门。或者……任何一天都不可能。

lines.en: : Unless you’re absolutely insistent that we should. In that case, I’d probably make an exception. But even then, I’d only be pretending to be okay with it in order to make you happy.
lines.zh: : 除非你坚持认为我们应该出门。那样的话，我大概会破个例。但即便如此，我也只是假装乐意，好让你开心。

lines.en: : I wish you’d learn to be antisocial in fewer words.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你能用更少的话来表达你的社交恐惧。

lines.en: : Me too. Incessant self deprecation can be really tiring.
lines.zh: : 我也希望。没完没了的自我贬低真的挺累人的。

lines.en: scene iocomesover14
: Anyway, I didn’t have any concrete plans. I just figured that whatever was going to happen in here would involve a little less murder and a little more...intimacy.
lines.zh: : 总之，我并没有什么明确的计划。我只是觉得，在这里会发生的事情，大概应该少一点谋杀、多一点……亲密。

lines.en: scene iocomesover15
: Oh...Hahah...Yeah...
lines.zh: : 哦……哈哈……是啊……

lines.en: : Yeah, I...I don’t know. It’s just...still my first time over and...
lines.zh: : 是啊，我……我不知道。只是……毕竟我还是第一次来，而且……

lines.en: : You know, just barging into your room to play games without really thinking about any of the consequences or how that would look is starting to sound like a pretty amateur move.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，就这么一头冲进你的房间打游戏，完全没想过后果、也没想过这看起来像什么，现在听起来真是个相当业余的举动。

lines.en: : You were excited. It happens. Besides, for someone who spends virtually their entire life {i}thinking,{/i} you kind of suck at it. So this is to be expected.
lines.zh: : 你当时太兴奋了。这种事难免。再说了，对于一个几乎一辈子都在{i}思考{/i}的人来说，你这方面还挺烂的。所以这也是意料之中。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’d think that after years and years of repeated failure and endless misery that maybe my brain would self-correct and cause me to act a little less shitty, but alas.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你大概会觉得，在年复一年的反复失败和无尽的痛苦之后，我的大脑总该自我修正一下，让我别表现得那么糟糕，可惜啊。

lines.en: : Is, uhh...
: Is...{i}intimacy{/i} really your go-to when people come over here, though? Cause, like...there’s no way I’m the first, right?
lines.zh: : 那个……不过别人来你这儿的时候，你真的都会直奔「{i}亲密{/i}」吗？因为……我不可能是第一个吧？

lines.en: : You’re the first girl to ever come into this room, Io.
lines.zh: : 你是第一个进过这个房间的女生，Io。

lines.en: scene iocomesover16
: Can you at least make your lies sound {i}a little{/i} convincing so I can trick myself into believing them?
lines.zh: : 你能不能至少把谎话编得{i}像样一点{/i}，好让我能骗自己去相信？

lines.en: : You were going to beat yourself up no matter what I responded with right there. I know you. Avoiding that topic entirely is the best way to prevent that from happening.
lines.zh: : 不管我刚才怎么回答，你都一定会自责。我了解你。彻底回避这个话题才是防止那种事发生的最好办法。

lines.en: scene iocomesover17

: I mean...we don’t have to {i}avoid{/i} it. Avoiding things makes stuff awkward. And if we keep avoiding stuff, we’ll wind up just sitting here in silence for the rest of the day and that sounds like it would bore you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们也不必{i}回避{/i}。回避会让事情变得尴尬。而且如果我们一直回避，最后就会这么沉默地坐上一整天，那听起来会让你很无聊。

lines.en: : I can turn the game volume up. At least it wouldn’t be silent then.
lines.zh: : 我可以把游戏音量调大。那样至少不算是安静了。

lines.en: scene iocomesover18
: J...Just for clarity’s sake, what did you mean by “intimacy?”
lines.zh: : 那……那个，为了确认一下，你说的「亲密」是什么意思？

lines.en: : Should I not have asked that? Did I just make a mistake?
lines.zh: : 我不该问这个吗？我是不是搞错了？

lines.en: : Because different people have different definitions of that word and I think I might just be misinterpreting {i}your{/i} definition of it and turning this into a thing when it’s not a thing at all.
lines.zh: : 因为不同的人对这个词有不同的定义，我想我可能误解了{i}你{/i}的定义，把本来不是一回事的事变成了一回事。

lines.en: : Just assume that my definition of the word is whatever {i}your{/i} definition of the word is. That sounds like the easiest way to end this.
lines.zh: : 就假设我对这个词的定义和{i}你{/i}的一样吧。这听起来是结束这个话题最简单的办法。

lines.en: : If our definitions of that word are the same, then I {i}am{/i} turning this into a thing- because I’d be totally fine with intimacy if it’s like, Io intimacy....Iontimacy. Sorry. That wasn’t funny. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 如果我们对这个词的定义一样，那我{i}就是{/i}在把这件事变成一件事——因为如果是 Io 式的亲密……Iontimacy……我就完全没问题。抱歉。那个不好笑。对不起。

lines.en: : Even though we have the same definitions, I feel like I should ask you what your brand of intimacy is.
lines.zh: : 即便我们的定义相同，我觉得我还是该问一句，你的那种亲密是什么样的。

lines.en: : Uhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: scene iocomesover19
: Like...
lines.zh: : 就比如……

lines.en: : Cuddling?...
: Or something?...
lines.zh: : 或者之类的？……

lines.en: : Why are you getting so flustered? We’ve “cuddled” in your room several times before, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么慌？我们之前不是在你的房间里「抱」过好几次了吗？

lines.en: : Yes...but also no? Never like this, at least. Never in {i}your{/i} room. And never when we’re...so alone.
lines.zh: : 是……但也不是？至少从没像现在这样。从没在{i}你{/i}的房间里。也从没在我们……这么独处的时候。

lines.en: : Are you nervous?
lines.zh: : 你紧张吗？

lines.en: scene iocomesover20
: Yes, but only that you’ll realize you don’t want anything to do with me anymore.
lines.zh: : 紧张，但只是怕你会意识到，你再也不想跟我有任何关系了。

lines.en: : That’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 那不会发生。

lines.en: : Do you promise?
lines.zh: : 你保证？

lines.en: : Sure. If promising that somehow reassures you, I’ll promise it as often as you want.
lines.zh: : 当然。如果向你保证能让你安心，你想让我保证多少次都行。

lines.en: : I’m not going anywhere. And no, I’m not just saying that because I live here.
lines.zh: : 我不会走的。而且不，我不是因为住在这里才这么说的。

lines.en: : You won’t leave even if I’m full of disappointments?
lines.zh: : 就算我满身都是让人失望的地方，你也不会离开？

lines.en: : If I was going to abandon you, I would have done it already. I’m in this for the long haul at this point.
lines.zh: : 如果我要抛弃你，早就抛弃了。事到如今，我是打算陪你走到底的。

lines.en: scene iocomesover21
: The...long haul...
lines.zh: : 走……走到底……

lines.en: scene iocomesover22
: W...Wow! Your bed looks so...comfortable...
lines.zh: : 哇……哇哦！你的床看起来好……舒服……

lines.en: : Is it okay if I...lay down on it for a little while to test it out?
lines.zh: : 我……可以躺一会儿试试吗？

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: scene iocomesover23
: Oooooh...so...good. Or...soft. Or something...
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦……好……舒服。或者……好软。还是什么的……

lines.en: : If only I...had someone to cuddle with me. Then I’d...{i}really{/i} be able to form a solid opinion on the...marketability of this...mattress...
lines.zh: : 要是……有个人能抱着我就好了。那样我{i}就能{/i}……对这张……床垫的……市场潜力……形成一个可靠的判断了……

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : Yes, I’m awkward! I’m sorry! That was your cue! We played enough of the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon and now it’s time to do what you want so you won’t hate me!
lines.zh: : 是的，我很别扭！对不起！那本来就是给你的暗示！1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》我们已经玩够了，现在是时候做你想做的事了，这样你就不会讨厌我了！

lines.en: : I’m not going-
lines.zh: : 我不会——

lines.en: : I also just want to cuddle now and am only saying things like that because it’s too hard to admit and accept the truth!
lines.zh: : 而且我现在就是想抱抱，之所以说那些话，只是因为承认并接受这个事实实在太难了！

lines.en: : What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : Nothing. Just thinking that I probably should have asked for three hours instead of two.
lines.zh: : 没什么。只是在想，我大概应该要三个小时而不是两个。

lines.en: scene black
I close the laptop and make my way over to the bed, climbing over Io so I can take my place behind her as the big spoon.
lines.zh: 我合上笔记本电脑，走向床边，翻过 Io 躺到她身后，当起了大勺。

lines.en: How things came to this when I already accepted that they {i}wouldn’t,{/i} I have no clue.
lines.zh: 事情怎么会变成这样，我明明已经接受了它们{i}不会{/i}变成这样，我却毫无头绪。

lines.en: scene iocomesover24

But I’m glad that they did- for the sensation of this paperthin bundle of contradictions that smells vaguely of blueberry shampoo pressing up against me fills me with my {i}own{/i} set of contradictions.
lines.zh: 但我很高兴它们变成了这样——因为这个浑身矛盾的纸片人身上带着淡淡的蓝莓洗发水味，她贴着我的感觉，让我心里也生出了属于{i}我自己{/i}的那套矛盾。

lines.en: The acceptance I felt just moments ago begins a painful metamorphosis into doubt. But not just the doubt of myself- the doubt of everyone around me.
lines.zh: 片刻前我感受到的那种接受，开始痛苦地蜕变成怀疑。但不仅仅是怀疑我自己——而是怀疑我身边的每一个人。

lines.en: We can not predict the future. And even those who think they know each other most can be hazy on the details if they have not pried in the right places at the right times.
lines.zh: 我们无法预知未来。即便是那些自认最了解彼此的人，如果没有在正确的时间、正确的地点深挖过，细节也可能是一片模糊。

lines.en: Would Uta have been able to predict that Io would not hesitate in calling me to bed?
lines.zh: Uta 能预想到 Io 会毫不犹豫地叫我上床吗？

lines.en: Would she have been able to predict that her fingers would crawl inside of my sleeve and pull me closer to her?
lines.zh: 她能预想到 Io 的手指会钻进我的袖子里，把我拉得更近吗？

lines.en: That she’d trust me so much she’d close her eyes just minutes after hearing about my anticipation and expectation of intimacy?
lines.zh: 能预想到她会如此信任我，在听到我对亲密的期待与预期之后仅仅几分钟就闭上眼睛吗？

lines.en: Of course not.
lines.zh: 当然不能。

lines.en: Because Uta doesn’t know Io as well as she thinks she does.
lines.zh: 因为 Uta 并没有她自以为的那么了解 Io。

lines.en: But I do.
lines.zh: 但我了解。

lines.en: I do, because Io is me.
lines.zh: 我了解，因为 Io 就是我。

lines.en: I know what Io wants, because I am Io.
lines.zh: 我知道 Io 想要什么，因为我就是 Io。

lines.en: We are one and the same- two broken people who have given up on themselves and must now find solace through the embrace of the opposite sex.
lines.zh: 我们是一体的——两个已经放弃了自己的残缺之人，如今必须通过与异性的拥抱来寻求慰藉。

lines.en: Would she truly have come here without the expectation that we’d end up like this?
lines.zh: 她真的会来这儿，却完全没预料到我们最后会变成这样吗？

lines.en: Would she truly give in so easily?
lines.zh: 她真的会这么轻易就缴械投降吗？

lines.en: She likes me.
lines.zh: 她喜欢我。

lines.en: She likes me and she wants to be intimate with me.
lines.zh: 她喜欢我，她想和我亲密。

lines.en: I want to be intimate with her.
lines.zh: 我想和她亲密。

lines.en: I want to take her {s}costume{/s} shorts off.
lines.zh: 我想脱掉她的{s}角色扮演{/s}短裤。

lines.en: I want to be intimate with her.
lines.zh: 我想和她亲密。

lines.en: I want-
lines.zh: 我想——

lines.en: : This is...
: The most peaceful I’ve felt in a really long time, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我很久没有这么平静过了，Sensei……

lines.en: : I really wish you’d let me be your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你能让我做你的女朋友。

lines.en: scene iocomesover25
: Maybe one day.
lines.zh: : 也许有一天吧。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: She likes me.
lines.zh: 她喜欢我。

lines.en: She likes me and she wants to be with me.
lines.zh: 她喜欢我，她想和我在一起。

lines.en: I want to be with her.
lines.zh: 我想和她在一起。

lines.en: She will tell me to stop if she wants me to stop.
lines.zh: 如果她不想，她会让我停下的。

lines.en: : Does this room smell strange to you?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得这个房间有股奇怪的味道吗？

lines.en: : Does...huh? Strange how?
lines.zh: : 什么……啊？奇怪？怎么个奇怪法？

lines.en: : Do you not like blueberries? I can wear something else if you-
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢蓝莓味吗？我可以换一款——

lines.en: : It’s like Spring.
lines.zh: : 像春天。

lines.en: : Spring?...
scene iocomesover26
: Um-
: Why doesn’t it exist anymore?
lines.zh: : 为什么它已经不存在了？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Why do I remember a season we don’t have?
lines.zh: : 为什么我会记得一个我们并没有的季节？

lines.en: : Why do I remember the scent of what can not exist anymore?
lines.zh: : 为什么我会记得一种不可能再存在的气味？

lines.en: scene iocomesover27
: Why do you think that is?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这是为什么呢？

SHE LIKES ME

lines.zh: 如果她不想，她会让我停下

scene iocomesover29
: Okay! Uhh...I just remembered that, umm...
lines.zh: : 好！呃……我刚刚想起来，嗯……

lines.en: : My day off is, uhh...actually {i}tomorrow...{/i}hahah...
lines.zh: : 我的休息日，呃……其实是{i}明天{/i}……哈哈……

lines.en: : What just-
lines.zh: : 刚才怎么——

lines.en: scene iocomesover30
: It’s...It’s fine! Really! It’s not you! I’m just...kind of weird when it...yeah...
lines.zh: : 没……没事的！真的！不是你的问题！我只是……在那种时候……有点奇怪……嗯……

lines.en: : But, uhh...I had a lot of fun today! I’m sorry I had to go and ruin it at the end...
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……我今天玩得很开心！抱歉我最后还是把气氛搞砸了……

lines.en: scene iocomesover31
: And...uhh...
: It was...a lot of fun and...wait- I already said that.
lines.zh: : 今天……很开心，而且……等等——这句我说过了。

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene iocomesover30
: I love you! Or...umm...like you! Whichever one I said the...last time and...
lines.zh: : 我爱你！或者……嗯……喜欢你！上次我说的那个是哪个来着，还有……

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: : Please don’t hate me...
lines.zh: : 请你不要讨厌我……

lines.en: scene iocomesover32
Io runs out of the room.
lines.zh: Io 冲出了房间。

lines.en: scene black
I catch up on sleep.
lines.zh: 我把觉补了回来。
